_comment: Rig profiles for NCM wheel support. DATA, not code -- nothing about anyone's hardware belongs in the
program. Every entry is optional; a rig with no matching profile still steers, because roles are
detected by shape (see `_detection`). A profile only adds what detection cannot know: which button on an
Matching is by case-insensitive substring against the SDL device name, most specific first. Standard
gamepads need no entry at all -- SDL's GameController database already maps them.
To add your own rim: run `ncm-wheel.py --bind`, press each control when asked, and it writes a profile
here. Nothing needs editing by hand.

_detection.steering: an axis that rests near centre and travels both ways
_detection.pedals: axes that rest at one END of travel
_detection.gamepad: anything SDL recognises as a game controller
